    pager: str | None = None
    custom_highlights: list[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = field(default_factory=list)
    enabled_groups: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    disabled_groups: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    disable_builtin_keywords: bool = False
    file_path: str | None = None


@dataclass
class TokenMatch:
    end: int
    rendered: str


def is_word_char(ch: str) -> bool:
    return ch in WORD_CHARS


def has_word_boundary(text: str, start: int, end: int) -> bool:
    left_ok = start == 0 or not is_word_char(text[start - 1])
    right_ok = end == len(text) or not is_word_char(text[end])
    return left_ok and right_ok


def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[str, Options | None]:
    options = Options()
    positionals: list[str] = []
    i = 0

    def require_value(current: str, display: str) -> str:
        nonlocal i
        if "=" in current and current.startswith("--"):
            return current.split("=", 1)[1]
        i += 1
        if i >= len(argv):
            raise CliError(2, f"error: a value is required for '{display}' but none was supplied{USAGE_FOOTER}")
        return argv[i]

    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        if arg == "--":
            positionals.extend(argv[i + 1 :])
            break
        if arg == "-h":
            return ("short_help", None)
        if arg == "--help":
            return ("long_help", None)
        if arg in ("-V", "--version"):
            return ("version", None)
        if arg in ("-f", "--follow"):
            options.follow = True
        elif arg in ("-p", "--print"):
            options.print_mode = True
        elif arg == "--disable-builtin-keywords":
            options.disable_builtin_keywords = True
        elif arg in ("--config-path",) or arg.startswith("--config-path="):
            options.config_path = require_value(arg, "--config-path <CONFIG_PATH>")
        elif arg in ("-e", "--exec") or arg.startswith("--exec="):
            options.exec_command = require_value(arg, "--exec <EXEC>")
        elif arg in ("--pager",) or arg.startswith("--pager="):
            options.pager = require_value(arg, "--pager <PAGER>")
        elif arg in ("--highlight",) or arg.startswith("--highlight="):
            raw = require_value(arg, "--highlight <COLOR_WORD>")
            options.custom_highlights.append(parse_highlight(raw))
        elif arg in ("--enable",) or arg.startswith("--enable="):
            raw = require_value(arg, "--enable <ENABLED_HIGHLIGHTERS>")
            options.enabled_groups.extend(parse_group_values(raw, "enable"))
        elif arg in ("--disable",) or arg.startswith("--disable="):
            raw = require_value(arg, "--disable <DISABLED_HIGHLIGHTERS>")
            options.disabled_groups.extend(parse_group_values(raw, "disable"))
        elif arg.startswith("-"):
            raise CliError(
                2,
                f"error: unexpected argument '{arg}' found\n\n  tip: to pass '{arg}' as a value, use '-- {arg}'{USAGE_FOOTER}",
            )
        else:
            positionals.append(arg)
        i += 1

    if len(positionals) > 1:
        extra = positionals[1]
        raise CliError(2, f"error: unexpected argument '{extra}' found{USAGE_FOOTER}")
    if positionals:
        options.file_path = positionals[0]
    return ("run", options)


def parse_group_values(raw: str, option: str) -> list[str]:
    values = [part for part in raw.split(",") if part]
    if not values:
        values = [raw]
    invalid = next((value for value in values if value not in VALID_GROUP_SET), None)
    if invalid is not None:
        option_name = "ENABLED_HIGHLIGHTERS" if option == "enable" else "DISABLED_HIGHLIGHTERS"
        raise CliError(
            2,
            "error: invalid value "
            f"'{invalid}' for '--{option} <{option_name}>'\n"
            "  [possible values: numbers, urls, pointers, dates, paths, quotes, key-value-pairs, uuids, "
            "ip-addresses, processes, json]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n",
        )
    return values


def parse_highlight(raw: str) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
    if ":" not in raw:
        raise CliError(
            2,
            f"error: invalid value '{raw}' for '--highlight <COLOR_WORD>': Expected format COLOR:word1,word2,... found `{raw}`\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n",
        )
    color, words = raw.split(":", 1)
    if color not in VALID_COLORS:
        raise CliError(
            2,
            f"error: invalid value '{raw}' for '--highlight <COLOR_WORD>': invalid variant: {color}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n",
        )
    parsed_words = tuple(word for word in words.split(",") if word)
    return (color, parsed_words)


def load_theme(config_path: str | None) -> dict[str, Style]:
    theme = default_theme()
    path: Path | None
    if config_path is None:
        path = default_config_path()
        if not path.exists():
            return theme
    else:
        path = Path(config_path)
        if not path.exists():
            raise RuntimeTspinError("Error:   × could not find the TOML file\n")

    assert path is not None
    raw_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    try:
        data = tomli.loads(raw_text)
    except tomli.TOMLDecodeError as exc:
        raise RuntimeTspinError(format_toml_error(raw_text, exc)) from exc

    apply_theme_config(theme, data)
    return theme


def default_config_path() -> Path:
    xdg_home = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg_home:
        return Path(xdg_home) / "tailspin" / "theme.toml"
    return Path.home() / ".config" / "tailspin" / "theme.toml"


def format_toml_error(source: str, exc: tomli.TOMLDecodeError) -> str:
    lineno = getattr(exc, "lineno", 1)
    colno = getattr(exc, "colno", 1)
    lines = source.splitlines()
    line = lines[lineno - 1] if 0 <= lineno - 1 < len(lines) else ""
    pointer = " " * max(colno - 1, 0) + "^"
    return (
        f"Error:   × TOML parse error at line {lineno}, column {colno}\n"
        "  │   |\n"
        f"  │ {lineno} | {line}\n"
        f"  │   | {pointer}\n"
        f"  │ {exc.msg}\n"
        "  │ \n"
    )


def apply_theme_config(theme: dict[str, Style], data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    def apply(slot: str, value: Any) -> None:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return
        theme[slot] = parse_style(value, theme[slot])

    if isinstance(data.get("numbers"), dict):
        apply("numbers", data["numbers"].get("style", data["numbers"]))

    if isinstance(data.get("dates"), dict):
        table = data["dates"]
        apply("date_date", table.get("date"))
        apply("date_time", table.get("time"))
        apply("date_separator", table.get("separator"))
        apply("date_literal", table.get("literal", table.get("marker")))

    if isinstance(data.get("urls"), dict):
        table = data["urls"]
        protocol = table.get("protocol")
        apply("url_http", protocol)
        apply("url_https", protocol)
        apply("url_host", table.get("hostname", table.get("host")))
        apply("url_path", table.get("path"))
        apply("url_query_literal", table.get("query_literal", table.get("query-literal")))
        apply("url_query_key", table.get("query_key", table.get("query-key")))
        apply("url_query_value", table.get("query_value", table.get("query-value")))

    if isinstance(data.get("paths"), dict):
        table = data["paths"]
        apply("path_root", table.get("root", table.get("separator")))
        apply("path_component", table.get("component", table.get("part")))
        apply("path_home", table.get("home", table.get("tilde")))

    if isinstance(data.get("quotes"), dict):
        apply("quote", data["quotes"].get("style", data["quotes"]))

    if isinstance(data.get("booleans"), dict):
        apply("boolean", data["booleans"].get("style", data["booleans"]))
    if isinstance(data.get("nulls"), dict):
        apply("null", data["nulls"].get("style", data["nulls"]))

    if isinstance(data.get("severity"), dict):
        table = data["severity"]
        apply("severity_info", table.get("info"))
        apply("severity_warn", table.get("warn"))
        apply("severity_debug", table.get("debug"))
        apply("severity_error", table.get("error"))
        apply("severity_trace", table.get("trace"))

    if isinstance(data.get("rest"), dict):
        table = data["rest"]
        apply("rest_get", table.get("get"))
        apply("rest_post", table.get("post"))
        apply("rest_put", table.get("put"))
        apply("rest_patch", table.get("patch"))
        apply("rest_delete", table.get("delete"))


def parse_style(value: dict[str, Any], current: Style) -> Style:
    fg = normalize_color(value.get("fg", value.get("foreground", value.get("color"))), background=False)
    bg = normalize_color(value.get("bg", value.get("background")), background=True)
    modifiers = value.get("modifiers", value.get("modifier", []))
    if isinstance(modifiers, str):
        modifiers = [modifiers]
    modifier_set = {str(mod).lower() for mod in modifiers} if isinstance(modifiers, list) else set()
    return replace(
        current,
        fg=fg if fg is not None else current.fg,
        bg=bg if bg is not None else current.bg,
        bold=bool(value.get("bold", current.bold)) or ("bold" in modifier_set),
        dim=bool(value.get("dim", current.dim)) or ("dim" in modifier_set) or ("dimmed" in modifier_set),
        italic=bool(value.get("italic", current.italic)) or ("italic" in modifier_set),
        underline=bool(value.get("underline", current.underline)) or ("underline" in modifier_set),
    )


def normalize_color(raw: Any, background: bool) -> str | None:
    if raw is None:
        return None
    text = str(raw).lower()
    if text in ("default", "none"):
        return None
    allowed = BACKGROUND_CODES if background else COLOR_CODES
    if text in allowed:
        return text
    return None


class Highlighter:
    def __init__(self, theme: dict[str, Style], options: Options) -> None:
        self.theme = theme
        self.disable_builtins = options.disable_builtin_keywords
        self.custom_highlights = options.custom_highlights
        if options.enabled_groups:
            self.groups = set(options.enabled_groups)
        else:
            self.groups = set(VALID_GROUPS) - set(options.disabled_groups)

    def highlight_text(self, text: str) -> str:
        pieces: list[str] = []
        for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
            if line.endswith("\n"):
                pieces.append(self.highlight_line(line[:-1]) + "\n")
            else:
                pieces.append(self.highlight_line(line))
        if not pieces and text == "":
            return ""
        return "".join(pieces)

    def highlight_line(self, line: str) -> str:
        if "json" in self.groups:
            json_rendered = self.try_render_json(line)
            if json_rendered is not None:
                return json_rendered

        out: list[str] = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(line):
            match = (
                self.match_url(line, i)
                or self.match_uuid(line, i)
                or self.match_pointer(line, i)
                or self.match_ip(line, i)
                or self.match_date(line, i)
                or self.match_path(line, i)
                or self.match_process(line, i)
                or self.match_key_value(line, i)
                or self.match_builtin(line, i)
                or self.match_custom(line, i)
                or self.match_quote(line, i)
                or self.match_number(line, i)
            )
            if match is None:
                out.append(line[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                out.append(match.rendered)
                i = match.end
        return "".join(out)

    def try_render_json(self, line: str) -> str | None:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            return None
        try:
            value = json.loads(stripped)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return None
        return self.render_json_value(value, top_level=True)

    def render_json_value(self, value: Any, top_level: bool = False) -> str:
        syntax = self.theme["json_syntax"]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            items = list(value.items())
            out = [paint(syntax, "{")]
            if not items:
                out.extend((" ", paint(syntax, "}")))
                return "".join(out)
            out.append(" ")
            for idx, (key, nested) in enumerate(items):
                if idx:
                    out.extend((paint(syntax, ","), " "))
                out.append(self.render_json_string(key, key_mode=True))
                out.extend((paint(syntax, ":"), " "))
                out.append(self.render_json_value(nested))
            out.extend((" ", paint(syntax, "}")))
            return "".join(out)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            out = [paint(syntax, "[")]
            for idx, item in enumerate(value):
                if idx:
                    out.extend((paint(syntax, ","), " "))
                out.append(self.render_json_value(item))
            out.append(paint(syntax, "]"))
            return "".join(out)
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return self.render_json_string(value, key_mode=False)
        if value is True:
            return paint(self.theme["boolean"], "true") if not self.disable_builtins else "true"
        if value is False:
            return paint(self.theme["boolean"], "false") if not self.disable_builtins else "false"
        if value is None:
            return paint(self.theme["null"], "null") if not self.disable_builtins else "null"
        text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        if "numbers" in self.groups:
            return paint(self.theme["numbers"], text)
        return text

    def render_json_string(self, value: str, key_mode: bool) -> str:
        rendered = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
        if key_mode:
            return paint(self.theme["json_syntax"], rendered)
        return paint(self.theme["json_syntax"], rendered[:1]) + rendered[1:-1] + paint(self.theme["json_syntax"], rendered[-1:])

    def match_url(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "urls" not in self.groups:
            return None
        scheme: str | None = None
        if text.startswith("https://", start):
            scheme = "https"
        elif text.startswith("http://", start):
            scheme = "http"
        if scheme is None:
            return None

        i = start + len(scheme) + 3
        host_start = i
        while i < len(text) and text[i] not in "/?:#" and text[i] not in URL_STOP_CHARS:
            i += 1
        if i == host_start:
            return None

        out = [
            paint(self.theme["url_https" if scheme == "https" else "url_http"], scheme),
            "://",
            paint(self.theme["url_host"], text[host_start:i]),
        ]

        if i < len(text) and text[i] == "/":
            path_start = i
            while i < len(text) and text[i] not in "?#" and text[i] not in URL_STOP_CHARS:
                i += 1
            out.append(paint(self.theme["url_path"], text[path_start:i]))

        if i < len(text) and text[i] == "?":
            out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_literal"], "?"))
            i += 1
            query_start = i
            while i < len(text) and text[i] not in "# " and text[i] not in URL_STOP_CHARS:
                i += 1
            out.append(self.render_url_query(text[query_start:i]))
        return TokenMatch(i, "".join(out))

    def render_url_query(self, query: str) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        for idx, part in enumerate(query.split("&")):
            if idx:
                out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_literal"], "&"))
            if "=" in part:
                key, value = part.split("=", 1)
                out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_key"], key))
                out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_literal"], "="))
                out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_value"], value))
            else:
                out.append(paint(self.theme["url_query_key"], part))
        return "".join(out)

    def match_uuid(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "uuids" not in self.groups:
            return None
        match = UUID_RE.match(text, start)
        if not match:
            return None
        end = match.end()
        if not has_word_boundary(text, start, end):
            return None
        return TokenMatch(end, self.render_hex_token(text[start:end], "uuid"))

    def match_pointer(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "pointers" not in self.groups:
            return None
        if not text.startswith("0x", start):
            return None
        if start > 0 and is_word_char(text[start - 1]):
            return None
        for length in (16, 8):
            end = start + 2 + length
            if end > len(text):
                continue
            body = text[start + 2 : end]
            if any(ch not in HEX_CHARS for ch in body):
                continue
            if end < len(text) and is_word_char(text[end]):
                continue
            return TokenMatch(end, self.render_pointer(text[start:end]))
        return None

    def render_pointer(self, token: str) -> str:
        body = token[2:]
        out = [paint(self.theme["pointer_digit"], "0"), paint(self.theme["pointer_prefix"], "x")]
        if len(body) == 16:
            first, second = body[:8], body[8:]
            out.extend(self.render_hex_body(first, "pointer"))
            out.append(paint(self.theme["pointer_bullet"], "•"))
            out.extend(self.render_hex_body(second, "pointer"))
            return "".join(out)
        out.extend(self.render_hex_body(body, "pointer"))
        return "".join(out)

    def render_hex_body(self, body: str, prefix: str) -> list[str]:
        digit_style = self.theme[f"{prefix}_digit"]
        hex_style = self.theme[f"{prefix}_hex"]
        out: list[str] = []
        for ch in body:
            out.append(paint(digit_style if ch.isdigit() else hex_style, ch))
        return out

    def match_ip(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "ip-addresses" not in self.groups:
            return None
        if start > 0 and is_word_char(text[start - 1]):
            return None
        if text[start] not in HEX_CHARS and text[start] != ":":
            return None
        end = start
        while end < len(text) and (text[end] in HEX_CHARS or text[end] in ".:"):
            end += 1
        candidate = text[start:end]
        if "." not in candidate and ":" not in candidate:
            return None
        for probe_end in range(end, start, -1):
            piece = text[start:probe_end]
            if not piece or piece[-1] in ".:":
                continue
            try:
                ipaddress.ip_address(piece)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if probe_end < len(text) and is_word_char(text[probe_end]):
                continue
            return TokenMatch(probe_end, self.render_ip(piece))
        return None

    def render_ip(self, token: str) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        for ch in token:
            if ch.isdigit():
                out.append(paint(self.theme["ip_digit"], ch))
            elif ch in ".:":
                out.append(paint(self.theme["ip_separator"], ch))
            else:
                out.append(paint(self.theme["ip_hex"], ch))
        return "".join(out)

    def match_date(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "dates" not in self.groups:
            return None
        if (match := SYSLOG_WITH_WEEKDAY_RE.match(text, start)) is not None:
            weekday, month, day, hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac = match.groups()
            rendered = f"{weekday} {month} {paint(self.theme['numbers'], day)}"
            rendered += paint(self.theme["date_literal"], " ")
            rendered += self.render_time(hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac)
            return TokenMatch(match.end(), rendered)
        if (match := SYSLOG_RE.match(text, start)) is not None:
            month, day, hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac = match.groups()
            rendered = f"{month} {paint(self.theme['numbers'], day)}"
            rendered += paint(self.theme["date_literal"], " ")
            rendered += self.render_time(hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac)
            return TokenMatch(match.end(), rendered)
        if (match := ISO_DATETIME_RE.match(text, start)) is not None:
            year, sep, month, day, literal, hour, _, minute, _, second, frac_sep, frac, suffix = match.groups()
            rendered = self.render_date(year, sep, month, day)
            rendered += paint(self.theme["date_literal"], literal)
            rendered += self.render_time(hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac)
            if suffix:
                rendered += paint(self.theme["date_literal"], suffix)
            return TokenMatch(match.end(), rendered)
        if (match := ISO_DATE_RE.match(text, start)) is not None:
            year, sep, month, day = match.groups()
            return TokenMatch(match.end(), self.render_date(year, sep, month, day))
        if (match := TIME_RE.match(text, start)) is not None:
            hour, _, minute, _, second, frac_sep, frac = match.groups()
            return TokenMatch(match.end(), self.render_time(hour, minute, second, frac_sep, frac))
        return None

    def render_date(self, year: str, sep: str, month: str, day: str) -> str:
        return (
            paint(self.theme["date_date"], year)
            + paint(self.theme["date_separator"], sep)
            + paint(self.theme["date_date"], month)
            + paint(self.theme["date_separator"], sep)
            + paint(self.theme["date_date"], day)
        )

    def render_time(
        self,
        hour: str,
        minute: str,
        second: str,
        frac_sep: str | None,
        frac: str | None,
    ) -> str:
        rendered = (
            paint(self.theme["date_time"], hour)
            + paint(self.theme["date_separator"], ":")
            + paint(self.theme["date_time"], minute)
            + paint(self.theme["date_separator"], ":")
            + paint(self.theme["date_time"], second)
        )
        if frac_sep:
            rendered += paint(self.theme["date_separator"], frac_sep)
            if frac:
                rendered += paint(self.theme["date_time"], frac)
        return rendered

    def match_path(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "paths" not in self.groups:
            return None
        if text[start] not in "/~":
            return None
        if start > 0 and (is_word_char(text[start - 1]) or text[start - 1] == ":"):
            return None

        i = start
        if text[i] == "~":
            i += 1
        while i < len(text) and text[i] == "/":
            i += 1

        component_start = i
        while i < len(text):
            while i < len(text) and text[i] not in "/ \t\r\n\"')#":
                if text[i] not in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789._-":
                    break
                i += 1
            if i == component_start:
                break
            if i < len(text) and text[i] == "/":
                i += 1
                component_start = i
                continue
            break

        if i == start or text[start:i] in ("/", "~"):
            return None
        if i < len(text) and text[i - 1] == "/":
            i -= 1
        return TokenMatch(i, self.render_path(text[start:i]))

    def render_path(self, token: str) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        i = 0
        if token.startswith("~"):
            out.append(paint(self.theme["path_home"], "~"))
            i = 1
        while i < len(token):
            if token[i] == "/":
                out.append(paint(self.theme["path_root"], "/"))
                i += 1
                continue
            j = i
            while j < len(token) and token[j] != "/":
                j += 1
            out.append(paint(self.theme["path_component"], token[i:j]))
            i = j
        return "".join(out)

    def match_process(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "processes" not in self.groups:
            return None
        match = PROCESS_RE.match(text, start)
        if not match:
            return None
        full = match.group(0)
        name, pid = full.split("[", 1)
        pid = pid[:-1]
        rendered = (
            paint(self.theme["process_name"], name)
            + paint(self.theme["process_bracket"], "[")
            + paint(self.theme["process_pid"], pid)
            + paint(self.theme["process_bracket"], "]")
        )
        return TokenMatch(match.end(), rendered)

    def match_key_value(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "key-value-pairs" not in self.groups:
            return None
        if start > 0 and is_word_char(text[start - 1]):
            return None
        match = KEY_VALUE_RE.match(text, start)
        if not match:
            return None
        raw = match.group(0)
        return TokenMatch(
            match.end(),
            paint(self.theme["kv_key"], raw[:-1]) + paint(self.theme["kv_separator"], "="),
        )

    def match_builtin(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if self.disable_builtins:
            return None

        for token, slot in (
            ("INFO", "severity_info"),
            ("WARN", "severity_warn"),
            ("DEBUG", "severity_debug"),
            ("ERROR", "severity_error"),
            ("TRACE", "severity_trace"),
            ("true", "boolean"),
            ("false", "boolean"),
            ("null", "null"),
        ):
            end = start + len(token)
            if text.startswith(token, start) and has_word_boundary(text, start, end):
                return TokenMatch(end, paint(self.theme[slot], token))

        for token, slot in (
            ("GET", "rest_get"),
            ("POST", "rest_post"),
            ("PUT", "rest_put"),
            ("PATCH", "rest_patch"),
            ("DELETE", "rest_delete"),
        ):
            end = start + len(token)
            if text.startswith(token, start) and has_word_boundary(text, start, end):
                return TokenMatch(end, paint(self.theme[slot], f" {token} "))
        return None

    def match_custom(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        for color, words in self.custom_highlights:
            style = Style(fg=color)
            for word in words:
                end = start + len(word)
                if text.startswith(word, start) and has_word_boundary(text, start, end):
                    return TokenMatch(end, paint(style, word))
        return None

    def match_quote(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "quotes" not in self.groups or text[start] != '"':
            return None
        end = text.find('"', start + 1)
        if end == -1:
            return None
        inner = text[start + 1 : end]
        if self.line_has_nonquote_match(inner):
            return None
        return TokenMatch(end + 1, paint(self.theme["quote"], text[start : end + 1]))

    def line_has_nonquote_match(self, text: str) -> bool:
        i = 0
        while i < len(text):
            match = (
                self.match_url(text, i)
                or self.match_uuid(text, i)
                or self.match_pointer(text, i)
                or self.match_ip(text, i)
                or self.match_date(text, i)
                or self.match_path(text, i)
                or self.match_process(text, i)
                or self.match_key_value(text, i)
                or self.match_builtin(text, i)
                or self.match_custom(text, i)
                or self.match_number(text, i)
            )
            if match is not None:
                return True
            i += 1
        return False

    def match_number(self, text: str, start: int) -> TokenMatch | None:
        if "numbers" not in self.groups or not text[start].isdigit():
            return None
        if start > 0 and is_word_char(text[start - 1]):
            return None
        end = start
        while end < len(text) and text[end].isdigit():
            end += 1
        if end < len(text) and text[end] == "." and end + 1 < len(text) and text[end + 1].isdigit():
            end += 1
            while end < len(text) and text[end].isdigit():
                end += 1
        if end < len(text) and is_word_char(text[end]):
            return None
        return TokenMatch(end, paint(self.theme["numbers"], text[start:end]))

    def render_hex_token(self, token: str, prefix: str) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        digit_style = self.theme[f"{prefix}_digit"]
        hex_style = self.theme[f"{prefix}_hex"]
        separator_style = self.theme[f"{prefix}_separator"]
        for ch in token:
            if ch.isdigit():
                out.append(paint(digit_style, ch))
            elif ch == "-":
                out.append(paint(separator_style, ch))
            else:
                out.append(paint(hex_style, ch))
        return "".join(out)


def read_text_stream(stream: Any) -> str:
    data = stream.buffer.read() if hasattr(stream, "buffer") else stream.read()
    if isinstance(data, bytes):
        return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return data


def default_pager_command() -> str:
    if shutil.which("less"):
        return "less -R [FILE]"
    return "cat [FILE]"


def validate_pager_command(command: str) -> list[str]:
    if "[FILE]" not in command:
        raise RuntimeTspinError("Error:   × Could not parse custom pager command\n")
    try:
        return shlex.split(command)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise RuntimeTspinError("Error:   × Could not parse custom pager command\n") from exc


def run_pager(text: str, command: str) -> int:
    args = validate_pager_command(command)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as handle:
        handle.write(text)
        temp_path = handle.name
    try:
        final_args = [temp_path if part == "[FILE]" else part for part in args]
        subprocess.run(final_args, check=False)
    finally:
        try:
            os.unlink(temp_path)
        except OSError:
            pass
    return 0


def read_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise RuntimeTspinError(f"Error:   ⚠ {paint(Style(fg='yellow'), path)}: No such file or directory\n") from exc


def execute_command(command: str) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(command, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout


def should_print_stdout(options: Options) -> bool:
    return options.print_mode or not sys.stdout.isatty()


def handle_run(options: Options) -> int:
    if options.enabled_groups and options.disabled_groups:
        raise RuntimeTspinError("Error:   × cannot both enable and disable highlighters\n")
    if options.exec_command and options.file_path:
        raise RuntimeTspinError(f"Error:   × Cannot read from both file and {paint(Style(fg='magenta'), '--listen-command')}\n")

    theme = load_theme(options.config_path)
    highlighter = Highlighter(theme, options)

    if options.exec_command is not None:
        if not sys.stdout.isatty():
            return 0
        text = highlighter.highlight_text(execute_command(options.exec_command))
        if options.print_mode:
            sys.stdout.write(text)
            return 0
        pager = options.pager or os.environ.get("TAILSPIN_PAGER") or default_pager_command()
        return run_pager(text, pager)

    if options.file_path is not None:
        raw = read_file(options.file_path)
        rendered = highlighter.highlight_text(raw)
        if should_print_stdout(options):
            sys.stdout.write(rendered)
            return 0
        pager = options.pager or os.environ.get("TAILSPIN_PAGER") or default_pager_command()
        return run_pager(rendered, pager)

    incoming = read_text_stream(sys.stdin)
    if not incoming and sys.stdin.isatty():
        return 0
    sys.stdout.write(highlighter.highlight_text(incoming))
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    try:
        mode, options = parse_args(argv)
        if mode == "short_help":
            sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
            return 0
        if mode == "long_help":
            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
            return 0
        if mode == "version":
            sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT)
            return 0
        assert options is not None
        return handle_run(options)
    except CliError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(exc.message)
        return exc.code
    except RuntimeTspinError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(exc.message)
        return exc.code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
